name: WayriCAD Review
description: Review saved PCB, schematic and 3D views with anchored GitHub/GitLab comments.
description_full: Review saved KiCad designs using bundled KiCad WebView 1.1.1. Rotate PCB and schematic views without moving saved comment anchors; inspect 3D copper and pads. Draft point and region comments for GitHub/GitLab issues and PR/MR conversations or GitHub Discussions. Provider data remains authoritative and drafts are local until sent. KiCad 10 testing package. Native schematic selection and inline diff reviews are not supported.
